entities.name: Matilda Caragiu Marioțeanu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Matilda Caragiu Marioțeanu was a Romanian linguist. She studied in the University of Bucharest, where she became a professor, having also taught at the University of Salzburg and the Goethe University Frankfurt as an invited professor. Caragiu Marioțeanu was the sister of actor Toma Caragiu and sculptor Geta Caragiu.

entities.summary: Matilda Caragiu Marioțeanu was a Romanian linguist. She studied in the University of Bucharest, where she became a professor, having also taught at the University of Salzburg and the Goethe University Frankfurt as an invited professor. Caragiu Marioțeanu was the sister of actor Toma Caragiu and sculptor Geta Caragiu.
